messages:
nora: heads-up: a customer can't run the JS sample on Fastly Compute@Edge. runtime error: "Unexpected token 'export'" when importing from @redwood/inference. types also don't appear in their editor.
ishan: does their environment treat packages as CJS by default? dual-pkg conditional exports can confuse some edge resolvers.
mike: can you paste our current exports?
nora: pasted from their repro: ```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    },
    "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "type": "module"
}
```
taylor: yeah that's the pattern we've used, but splitting types to `./types` is causing TS lookup failures when bundlers rewrite imports to subpaths. also some edge resolvers pick the require path or ignore exports negotiation.
ishan: other observed problem: our retry/backoff util pulled in a node timers helper in the CJS build which isn't present on Fastly. customer saw crashes from `setImmediate` not defined. ESM build had a different tree-shake profile so it sometimes worked locally.
mike: short-term workaround: add an explicit "./edge": "./dist/esm/index.mjs" export and update the sample to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'`. unblock users, then ship proper fix.
nora: agreed. proposal for long-term: 1) make `.` ESM-first (import -> esm, require -> cjs fallback), 2) consolidate types into the main export object so TS can resolve (`".": { "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }`), 3) add `module` and `browser` fields pointing at ESM artifacts for older bundlers, 4) produce `.mjs` artifacts for ESM to avoid ambiguous loaders, 5) audit code paths so edge bundles never pull Node-only polyfills (timers, node-fetch, fs).
ishan: +1. i'll take the exports/types PR and publish a patch. mike: can you clean up the retry util so it prefers web globals (globalThis.setTimeout/AbortController) and falls back to tiny safe shims rather than node-only deps?
mike: on it. i'll add runtime guards and a small inline fallback to avoid pulling large polyfill packages into the edge build.
taylor: i'll add an edge smoke matrix in CI (Fastly Compute, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers) and a test that runs the sample and verifies import + basic request. if that fails, block the release.
ops-bot: created issues #4510 (pkg exports: ESM-first + types under main export) assigned to ishan, #4511 (retry util: web-safe timers + abort guard) assigned to mike, #4512 (edge smoke CI matrix) assigned to taylor.
nora: i'll update the sample app README with the temporary `/edge` import and a note about edge runtimes until PR lands. also will paste the repro into the issue so we have a concrete test case.
ishan: timeline: i'll open the PR today, cut a patch release once CI passes, then coordinate with docs to update migration notes.
mike: once patch is out i'll follow up with a short post in #devex summarizing the runtime gotchas (module resolution, timers/AbortController, fetch differences).
taylor: sounds good. keeping this thread as the quick tracker. if you hit other edge platforms (Bun/Deno/V8 isolates), drop the repros here.
